pr.name: Pull requests
pr.section.title: Pull requests
pr.section.desc: Shows the open pull requests of the current branch and of you with their CI and review state, through the GitHub CLI (gh). Read-only, started by you; nothing is merged, edited, closed, approved or commented.
pr.section.enableDesc: Adds the Pull requests tab and the Create pull request command. Off: no code is loaded.
pr.noGh.title: GitHub CLI not found
pr.noGh.desc: Install gh (for example brew install gh) and sign in with gh auth login in a terminal. This tab never pushes, merges or comments.
pr.jail.title: No GitHub calls in this mode
pr.noAuth.title: gh is not signed in
pr.noAuth.desc: Run gh auth login in a terminal, then refresh. The IDE never reads or stores the token.
pr.noneBranch: No open pull request for this branch.
pr.noneMine: No other open pull requests of yours.
pr.listBranchAria: Pull requests of the current branch
pr.empty.title: No open pull requests
pr.empty.desc: Create one from the current branch, or refresh.
pr.create.title: Create pull request
pr.create.desc: A draft is prepared from the commits ahead of the base. Nothing is pushed: the branch must already be on the remote.
pr.create.baseAria: Base branch of the pull request
pr.create.head: Head branch
pr.create.readyNote: Not a draft: reviewers are notified as soon as it is created.
pr.create.unpushed: {n, plural, one {# commit is} other {# commits are}} not pushed yet and will not be in the pull request. Push from the Push dialog first.
pr.create.commits: {n, plural, one {# commit ahead of the base} other {# commits ahead of the base}}
pr.create.commandHint: Exactly this runs after you click Create. It never pushes, merges, edits or comments.
pr.create.typeRepo: Type the repository name {name} to confirm
pr.create.typeRepoAria: Type the repository name to confirm
pr.create.typeHead: Type the head branch {name} to confirm
pr.create.typeHeadAria: Type the head branch to confirm
pr.create.failed: Could not create the pull request
pr.err.readOnly: Read-only mode: no GitHub call runs and no pull request is created.
pr.err.testJail: Test mode: only a fake gh inside the fixture runs, never the real one.
pr.err.noUpstream: This branch has no upstream. Push it from the Push dialog first; this never pushes.
pr.err.upstreamMismatch: This branch tracks a branch with another name, so the pull request head would not match.
pr.err.liveHead: A live branch can be the base of a pull request, never the head.
pr.err.detachedHead: HEAD is detached. Check out a branch first.
pr.err.noBase: No base branch was found on the remote.
pr.err.unknownBase: That base branch does not exist on the remote.
pr.err.sameBranch: The head and the base are the same branch.
pr.err.nothingAhead: The branch has no commits ahead of the base.
pr.err.confirmRequired: Type the repository name and the head branch exactly to confirm.
pr.err.ghMissing: The GitHub CLI (gh) was not found.
pr.err.ghAuth: gh is not signed in. Run gh auth login in a terminal.
doctor.title: System checks
doctor.desc: Tool versions, credentials, PATH, disk space, lock files, hooks and leftovers of the IDE. It only reports; nothing is deleted or changed except by the Fix button.
doctor.summary: {error, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}, {warn, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}, {ok} OK
doctor.unavailable: The system checks could not run.
doctor.tool.noVersion: {tool} was found but did not report a version
doctor.tool.missing: {tool} was not found on the login-shell PATH
doctor.cred.ok: A git credential helper is configured (names only, never values)
doctor.cred.none: No git credential helper is configured: pushes will ask for a password or fail
doctor.cred.plaintext: The store helper keeps credentials in a plain text file; osxkeychain is safer
doctor.path.loginFailed: The login shell could not be read: tools may be missing from the PATH the IDE uses
doctor.path.guiOk: The PATH this app was launched with contains the tool directories
doctor.path.guiMinimal: {count, plural, one {# tool directory is} other {# tool directories are}} missing from the PATH this app was launched with (usual for apps started from the Dock). The IDE reads your login shell itself.
doctor.path.untidy: The login PATH lists {missing, plural, one {# directory that does not exist} other {# directories that do not exist}} and {duplicates, plural, one {# duplicate} other {# duplicates}}
doctor.disk.ok: {free} free on the volume of the repositories and the IDE state
doctor.disk.low: Only {free} free (below {warnBelow}) on the volume of the repositories and the IDE state
doctor.lock.stale: {repo}: lock files older than {minutes} min (nothing is deleted; remove them yourself if no git command is running)
doctor.lock.fresh: {repo}: a lock file is present, a git command may be running
doctor.hooks.found: {repo}: {count, plural, one {# hook file} other {# hook files}}
doctor.hooks.foundAt: {repo}: {count, plural, one {# hook file} other {# hook files}} in core.hooksPath {hooksPath}
doctor.hooks.notExecutable: {repo}: hook files that are not executable (git skips them)
doctor.untracked.large: {repo}: large untracked directories{capped, select, true { (counted up to 20000 entries)} other {}}: they slow git status and can be committed by accident
doctor.orphans.none: No sidecar, claude or git processes of the IDE were left behind
doctor.orphans.found: {count, plural, one {# process} other {# processes}} started by the IDE outlived it (nothing is stopped)
doctor.temp.none: No temporary IDE directories older than a day
doctor.temp.old: {count, plural, one {# temporary IDE directory} other {# temporary IDE directories}} older than a day, {bytes} in total (nothing is deleted)
